intro.title: Design DataTable API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a DataTable component API by designing its props to accept data and configuration options. You will learn how to structure a component's interface to make it reusable and flexible for different datasets. The core concept involves using React props to pass data and functions, such as an array of objects for rows and an array for column definitions. You'll work with JavaScript objects, arrays, and JSX to create a table that dynamically renders based on the provided props.
intro.usecase: DataTable APIs are essential for building enterprise dashboards, admin panels, and analytics tools where users need to sort, filter, and paginate large datasets. You'll find them in products like Salesforce's customer management interface, Shopify's order administration panels, and financial reporting dashboards where users interact with tabular data. As a developer, you'll implement these APIs to handle complex data operations while maintaining responsive UI performance. This pattern is crucial for any application displaying searchable, sortable tables with server-side data processing requirements.
